REVIEW-1 FINDINGS (.temp/tally/logs/h-hygiene/review-1.md):

- Finding 1 (LOW) fixed in d013145: useSealedMutation now memoises mutate and mutateAsync with useCallback on TanStack's stable mutate/mutateAsync (react-query 5.102.8: mutate is a useCallback on the observer, mutateAsync is observer.mutate bound in its constructor). Sealing unchanged.

- Finding 2 (LOW) fixed in d013145: credentialMutations.test.tsx went from 21 cases to 10. describe useSealedMutation: success, refused, unknown once on the helper, each followed by a retry, plus toBe checks that mutate and mutateAsync kept their identity across renders. describe mutations that send a credential: one success case per hook (7). Every case still scans every mutation.state (variables, context, error, failureReason, data) and the hook result, and asserts each request body carried the credential.

- Reader sweep (review section 5) completed by the coordinator: admin audit contract types entityVersion as int and metadata as z.unknown(); no admin feature, erasure or report reads audit metadata. No fix needed.

- Finding 3 (LOW) CARRIED, not fixed (owned by lane h-client): after an error, AccountPasswordPanel.tsx (~56-58) and ResetPasswordScreen.tsx (~47-49) keep the typed passwords in React form state while the form is mounted; the nominee, phone and email forms clear them. Component state, not the mutation cache. Also: ResetPasswordScreen keeps newPassword in state after success until unmount.

H-L5-hygiene (lane h-hygiene), 2026-11-14. Two commits on track/h-hygiene, on top of 8e26c31. Not pushed, not landed.
6456c92 fix(client): keep credentials out of the mutation cache
246fc6e fix(nominee): record the user's version on nominee audit rows
ITEM 1: password in the mutation cache (frontend only).

- New frontend_stack_ts/src/api/sealedMutation.ts: useSealedMutation gives TanStack a one-time Sealed holder. mutationFn opens it once while building the request, and it is null afterwards. retry is forced false. The hooks keep their call-site shape (mutate(input)), so no screen file changed.

- Searched: every contract request body with password/currentPassword/newPassword/token/refreshToken/code (web-auth, native-auth, admin-native-auth, client-web-auth, client-profile, client.ts verifyEmail, nominee.ts), every useMutation( in frontend_stack_ts/src, and the admin mutation modules.

- Same shape found and fixed in 7 hooks: useChangeClientNominee (nomineeQueries); useChangeClientPhone, useRequestEmailChange, useConfirmEmailChange (profileQueries); useRedeemPasswordReset, useChangePassword, useVerifyEmail (shared/queries).

- Not the shape: logins, refresh and logout go through shells/*Runtime.ts via http.request, not TanStack. No admin mutation sends a credential (passwordLinkQueries sends {} plus a key). HTTP errors (ApiError, TransportError) carry no request body.

- Idempotency: none of the 7 operations takes an Idempotency-Key (contracts say idempotency none). The admin nominee form's held key and Check again are unchanged; it sends no password. A client retry after an unknown outcome is a new submit, sealed again.

- Guard: src/features/shared/credentialMutations.test.tsx, 21 cases (7 hooks x success/refused/unknown, each followed by a retry). It scans the mutation states and the hook result, opening any holder, and asserts each body still carried the credential.
ITEM 2: nominee audit version (backend only, no migration).

- New user.nominee_changed rows: entity_version = users.version (selected in HOLDER_COLUMNS under the same FOR UPDATE lock), metadata.nomineeVersion = nominee_version. A nominee write still does not bump users.version, so the row repeats the user's current version, like user.email_change_requested.
- Existing rows are not rewritten. Plan C1 Audit bullet appended (old rows keep the nominee version and have no nomineeVersion key).

- Readers checked: admin audit list (entityVersion int, metadata z.unknown, so released admin APKs are fine); audit trail and per-client activity (AdminAuditTrailItem has neither field; derived keys are userId, amount keys, fundId, orderId, entryId); support events (support_request only); erasure scrub (text/contact replace; a number is unaffected); accountingReports test (own fixtures). nomineeBody maps fields explicitly, so userVersion never reaches a response. No new response key or enum.

- Correction: email_verification.code_requested/.completed looked like the same shape, but EmailVerificationRepository.start/markVerified update users and return users.version. Not an instance; unchanged.
